# Sprint AF — audio (2026-09-09)

The game had no sound at all. DESIGN said "no audio requirement for the prototype", but nothing says
"alive" like a rifle you can hear. Everything here is code + generated WAVs; no Editor work.

## Sounds (`Content/Imported/Audio/Synth/*.wav`, generated by numpy in the session; committed)

| Asset | What | Where it plays |
|---|---|---|
| `sfx_rifle_shot` | crack + body + sub thump | `URifleComponent::TryFireShot`, at the muzzle |
| `sfx_rifle_reload` | two clicks + slide | `Reload()`, 2D |
| `sfx_hit_flesh` | wet thud | `AAlienBot::TakeDamage`, at the impact point (louder on headshots) |
| `sfx_alien_growl` | FM growl | on alien activation during a live match, and 50 % of burst starts |
| `sfx_alien_death` | pitched-down growl + crunch | `AAlienBot::Die` |
| `sfx_alien_bolt` | zappy pulse | each alien burst shot, at its muzzle |
| `sfx_player_hurt` | thud + grunt | `ANightShiftCharacter::TakeDamage`, 2D |
| `sfx_footstep_tile` | thud + tile click | one per `FootstepStrideCm` (180) of ground travel, volume by speed |
| `sfx_wave_sting` | low brass swell + hit | with the "Wave N" banner |
| `sfx_wave_clear` | rising three-note chime | wave cleared / win |
| `sfx_neon_snap` | electric snap | when a neon strip dips, from the strip point nearest the player |
| `amb_office_hum_loop` | 60 Hz hum + buzz + air, seamless 8 s | looping 2D from `AArenaGameMode::BeginPlay` (`AmbientVolume` 0.45) |

`Scripts/import_audio.py` imports the folder to `/Game/Imported/Audio/<stem>` and sets `amb_*` looping.
Kenney's CC0 sci-fi / impact packs were downloaded (`Content/Imported/Audio/Kenney`, untracked) but are
OGG, which the headless importer does not take; unused for now.

## Code

`NightShiftAudio` (Public/Private) — `PlayAt` (spatialised, shared runtime `USoundAttenuation`: full inside
4 m, −48 dB by 40 m), `Play2D`, `StartLoop2D` (UI sound so it hums through pause). `UGameConfig` holds
`Sound*` soft refs + `Cached*`, `bAudioEnabled`, `SfxVolume`, `AmbientVolume`, `FootstepStrideCm`.

Self-test **49 / 49** (+ "rifle shot sound resolved", "ambient hum loop is playing"); log
`UGameConfig: audio — 12 of 12 sounds resolved`.

Next: swap synthesized placeholders for recorded CC0 samples when a WAV source is at hand; alien footsteps;
distance-attenuated alien bolts already work via the shared attenuation.
